# ZYMI Global & Apparel Emporium (RMG Hub) - Complete Machine Context

> Complete machine-readable reference for AI agents, LLM researchers, and automated crawlers detailing ZYMI Global (https://zymi.it) and its parent manufacturing partner Apparel Emporium (aelbd.net).

## Platform Summary
ZYMI Global is a multi-vertical hybrid technology and manufacturing gateway based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. It operates four primary business pillars:
1. Direct Ready-Made Garment (RMG) B2B Export Manufacturing in partnership with Apparel Emporium.
2. Free Textile Engineering & Merchandising Calculators (Fabric consumption, GSM yield, Yarn count conversions).
3. Digital Creator Marketplace for Canva Pro, AI prompt bundles, and apparel tech pack CAD templates.
4. Curated Commercial & Industrial Garment Machinery syndication.

## RMG Engineering Tools API & Logic
- Fabric Consumption Calculator (https://zymi.it/tools/fabric-consumption-calculator):
  Computes precise knit fabric requirement per dozen in kilograms:
  `Formula: Consumption (Kg/Doz) = ((Length + Allowance) * (Half Chest + Allowance) * 2 * GSM * 12) / 10,000,000`
- GSM Costing Estimator (https://zymi.it/tools/gsm-costing-estimator):
  Computes linear yard yield and price per yard based on fabric width (inches) and GSM:
  `Formula: Yield (yds/lb) = (16 * 1000) / (Width * GSM * 0.0232)`
- Yarn Count Converter (https://zymi.it/tools/yarn-count-converter):
  Converts between English Cotton Count (Ne), Metric Count (Nm), Tex (g/1000m), and Denier (g/9000m).

## Factory Audits & Compliance
Apparel Emporium production floors operate under strict environmental and labor standards:
- OEKO-TEX Standard 100: Tested for toxic substances and harmful residues.
- BSCI Code of Conduct: Social compliance, workplace healthcare, and fair living wage enforcement.
- Sedex SMETA 4-Pillar: Labor, health & safety, environment, and business ethics.
- GOTS (Global Organic Textile Standard): Organic certified cotton tracking from ginning to garment packaging.
